scenicChapters.title: Bergamo old town → Lake Iseo pause
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 40 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Passo Rolle and Valles Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: For 97 km this is Passo Rolle and Valles Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
